title: D1 migrations for the data model
description: D1 migrations for the data model.
acceptance: Tables exist for attestations, revocations, request_nonces, session_records, identity_bindings, signing_keys and audit_events
Columns match ATA-01:01; no column holds long-term identity or personal data
There is no attestation_nonces table: the attestation nonce is not a replay token
findings: Imported schema had attestation_nonces for client replay guards. The spec now uses verifier nonces (ATA-03:04) and request nonces at issuance, and adds session_records.
